title: LIFE
tagline: One supporter. One club. A whole life.
startOverConfirm: This erases the life saved on this device. Start again?
restartChapterNote: The day begins again from its morning. Everything before it stays.
boxEmpty: Nothing in it yet. Enough room for things worth keeping.
storyLanguage: The story is written in English. The Hebrew edition is in translation.
finishedNote: Every ending you reached is yours; none of them is the right one.
provenance: Composed from universal chapters and this club's approved archive rows. Nothing about history is added beyond what the archive records.
fiction: The family and the street are fiction. No real person speaks.
loadFailed: The room did not open. Check the connection and try again.
noWebgl: This device cannot draw the room. LIFE needs WebGL.
tapHint: Tap where you want to walk. Tap somebody to go to them.
game.tune.title: Find the station
game.tune.help: Turn the dial until the voice comes clear.
game.clap.title: Clap with them
game.clap.help: Clap when the ring closes. Nobody is counting.
game.clap.late: A beat behind. So is half the stand.
game.carry.title: Keep it steady
game.carry.help: Lean against the drift and keep the mark in the middle.
game.count.title: Count them
